ai_async_queue_max_jobs.description: Limit on number of jobs that will be run(serially) in a frame. - 1 = no limit

ai_gather_conditions_async.description: Allow gathering of conditions to be done asynchronously.

ai_think_interval_lod_low.description: Time interval between NPC thinks when set to AI LOD low.

ai_think_interval_lod_med.description: Time interval between NPC thinks when set to AI LOD medium.

ai_think_interval_lod_very_low.description: Time interval between NPC thinks when set to AI LOD very low.

animgraph_footlock_enabled.description: A master convar that effectively disables the entire footlock node.

animgraph_footlock_trace_ground_enabled.description: Convar for toggling foot lock ground tracking.

audio_enable_spawn_mask_mix_layer.description: Enables the mix layer which mutes certain sounds at map load boundaries.

audio_enclosure_calc_enabled.description: Enables/disabled calculations that determine entity interior vs exterior.

audio_viewing_damage_decay_time.description: Duration for viewing damage to decays to 0.0.

audio_viewing_damage_hold_time.description: Duration before viewing damage begins to decay.

cam_idealdelta.description: Controls the speed when matching offset to ideal angles in thirdperson view

cam_ideallag.description: Amount of lag used when matching offset to ideal angles in thirdperson view

cc_captiontrace.description: Show missing closecaptions (0 = no, 1 = devconsole, 2 = show in hud)

citadel_camera_height.description: The look at point of the camera is vertically offset by this distance.

citadel_camera_hero_fov.description: The field of view angle of the camera when following a hero.

citadel_camera_see_distance_max.description: Max Distance the camera can 'see' an entity

citadel_camera_soft_collision_angle.description: Soft camera collision cone arc angle in degrees. Larger cone angle results in earlier softening.

citadel_camera_use_vmdl_flatten_horizont.description: For each camera pose set, use the average of X positions. This is a motion sickness reducing action.

citadel_camera_use_vmdl_flatten_vertical.description: Zero the relative Z axis of the camera to reduce motion sickness.

citadel_damage_text_dynamic_emphasis.description: Dynamically emphasize damage number over a certain percent of the targets max health. See citadel_damage_text_dynamic_emphasis_percent

citadel_damage_text_follow_healthbar_sca.description: Damage text follows the victim's healthbar scale

citadel_damage_text_height_offset_far.description: How much to offset damage numbers above when far from the camera

citadel_damage_text_height_offset_near.description: How much to offset damage numbers above when near from the camera

citadel_damage_text_show_effectiveness.description: Show the damage effectiveness on every damage number

citadel_fibonnaci_sphere_trace_los_max.description: How big to cap the size of the sphere when checking for really large explosion/effects

citadel_hideout_ball_show_juggle_count.description: WIP Show juggle count on ball.

citadel_hideout_ball_show_juggle_fx.description: WIP Show fx when hitting apex/landing on floor.

citadel_hud_objective_health_enabled.description: Enable/Disable HUD-level objective health bars.  0=Off. 1=Shrines, Patron, Midboss. 2=T1s and T2s. 3=Barracks

citadel_hud_objective_health_idle_timeou.description: After how many seconds of an objective is damage to hide its health on the HUD

citadel_orb_debug_draw_state.description: Set to non-zero to draw state of orb. Value will be duration for state to linger after orb expires.

citadel_perf_interval_report_s.description: The interval that we record performance stats to the log at measured in seconds

citadel_shoot_forward_offset.description: How far forward from the plane of hero and camera forward to move the shoot position

citadel_show_old_neutral_camp_icons.description: Show the old neutral camp icons on the minimap

citadel_show_survey.description: A way to force the survey UI on even outside of matchmaking

citadel_unit_status_offset_player_z_offs.description: Z Offset for all charcters, indpendent of the vmdl offset.

cl_batch_entity_list_ops_during_latch.description: Batch entity list adds / removes while latching interpolated variables to avoid mutex contention.

cl_clock_buffer_ticks.description: Clock sync will try to maintain an additional margin of N ticks.  This is intended to smooth over packet loss, and is a replacement for cl_interp_ratio / cl_interp.  This value is simply added to cl_clock_recvmargin_desired

cl_disconnect_soundevent.description: This soundevent is called to stop the desired soundevents when the game is disconnected.

cl_interp_parallel.description: Run interpolation in parallel for entities with no children.

cl_interp_ratio.description: Sets the client simulation interpolation amount, in terms of server updates (final amount is cl_interp_ratio / cl_updaterate).

cl_particle_fallback_base.description: Base for falling back to cheaper effects under load.

cl_particle_fallback_multiplier.description: Multiplier for falling back to cheaper effects under load.

cl_particle_sim_fallback_base_multiplier.description: How aggressive the switch to fallbacks will be depending on how far over the cl_particle_sim_fallback_threshold_ms the sim time is.  Higher numbers are more aggressive.

cl_particle_sim_fallback_threshold_ms.description: Amount of simulation time that can elapse before new systems start falling back to cheaper versions

cl_phys_assume_fixed_tick_interval.description: If true, we assume the client uses a fixed tickrate like the server (which may not always be true). If false, we recalculate the number of physics substeps in each client tick based on the actual elapsed time in the tick.

cl_phys_sleep_enable.description: Enable sleeping for dynamic physics bodies.

cl_poll_network_early.description: Enable polling for network messages every frame, instead of every tick

cl_ragdoll_limit.description: Maximum number of ragdolls to show (-1 disables limit)

cl_resend.description: Delay in seconds before the client will resend the 'connect' attempt

cl_retire_low_priority_lights.description: Low priority dlights are replaced by high priority ones

cl_smoothtime.description: Smooth client's view after prediction error over this many seconds

cl_tickpacket_desired_queuelength.description: This value, multiplied by the tick interval, is added to cl_tickpacket_recvmargin_desired to obtain the effective desired recv margin.

cl_tickpacket_recvmargin_desired.description: Recvmargin-based usercommand pacing will try to maintain N ms margin between user command arriving at the server and the server needing that user command.  See also cl_tickpacket_desired_queuelength.

cl_updaterate.description: Number of packets per second of updates you are requesting from the server

cl_usesocketsforloopback.description: When connecting to local listen server (for example, using the 'map' command), default to loopback=false, which connects to '127.0.0.1' instead of 'loopback'.  This uses the network stack so that fake lag/loss can be simulated.

cloth_filter_transform_stateless.description: Enable the new, stateless version of FilterTransform

con_enable.description: Allows the console to be activated.

cq_buffer_bloat_msecs_max.description: Server will not allow the client to buffer up more than N ms of commands.

csm_max_num_cascades_override.description: Number of cascades in sunlight shadow

disable_source_soundscape_trace.description: Bypasses lookup of soundscapes for indvidual audio sources when enabled.

engine_accurate_input_processing_delta_t.description: When true, elapsed time given to the input processing will be the time elapsed since the last input processing. This is only relevant when input is processed multiple times per frame ( i.e. multiple ticks per frame)

engine_low_latency_sleep_after_client_ti.description: When r_low_latency is enabled, this moves the low latency sleep on tick frames to happen after client simulation.

engine_max_ticks_to_simulate.description: Max number of ticks to simulate per frame, after which simulation will start to slow down compared to real time.

ent_joint_lines.description: Draw a line between a rendered joint and its parent.

ent_joint_names.description: Draw the name of a rendered joint.

fps_max.description: Frame rate limiter.  0=no limit.  Does not apply to dedicated server.

fps_max_ui.description: Frame rate limiter while the game UI is displayed.  0=no limit.  Does not apply to dedicated server.

in_button_double_press_window.description: How short the time between presses needs to be for us to consider it a double-press

lb_barnlight_shadowmap_scale.description: Scale for computed barnlight shadowmap size

lb_csm_cascade_size_override.description: Override width/height of individual cascades in the CSM

lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades.description: Override Cascades that will render static objects with lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades_value

lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades_value.description: If lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades, override value used to determine which cascades render static objects

lb_csm_receiver_plane_depth_bias.description: Shader depth bias applied to shadow receiver (Note this conflicts with renderstate depth bias, both now default to 0)

lb_csm_receiver_plane_depth_bias_transmi.description: Depth bias applied to shadow receiver for transmissive backface geo (based on renderstate depthbias being 0)

lb_dynamic_shadow_penumbra.description: Adjust shadow penumbra based on light size

lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution_base.description: Base resolution for dynamic shadowmap sizing.  Shadowmap size of a screen sized light

lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution_quantizatio.description: Quantization of dynamically computed shadow size

lb_enable_shadow_casting.description: Allow stationary/dynamic lights to cast shadows.

lb_shadow_map_cull_empty_mixed.description: Don't render shadows for mixed shadowmaps with no dynamics objects in view

lb_shadow_texture_height_override.description: Override height of shadow atlas texture

lb_shadow_texture_width_override.description: Override width of shadow atlas texture

lb_sun_csm_size_cull_threshold_texels.description: Size, in texels, where we will cull an object in the shadowmap

mat_viewportscale.description: Scale down the main viewport (to reduce GPU impact on CPU profiling)

mm_prefer_solo_only.description: Prefer being matched with other solo players when not in a party

music_hideout_debug_enabled.description: Displays music manager debug info for hideout.

net_gather_child_fields_only.description: GatherSendProxyResults only walks struct and array fields, skipping scalar fields.

panorama_js_minidumps.description: Enable sending minidumps on JS Exceptions.

panorama_transition_time_factor.description: A float representing a scale factor for transitions. 1.0 is normal, 2.0 would be twice as fast as normal, 0.5 half as fast

props_break_max_pieces_perframe.description: Maximum prop breakable piece count per frame (-1 = model default)

r_aoproxy_cull_dist.description: Distance to cull the AO proxy as a factor of size

r_citadel_disable_particle_lights.description: Disable particle lights except when explicitly overriden in particle renderer ops.

r_citadel_fsr_enable_mip_bias.description: Apply negative mip bias when rendering with FSR.

r_citadel_npr_outlines_max_dist.description: Maximum distance at which NPR outlines are rendered

r_draw_particle_children_with_parents.description: Draw particle children with parents (-1=use gameinfo, 0=no, 1=yes)

r_drawtracers_firstperson.description: Toggle visibility of first person weapon tracers

r_dx11_software_cmd_lists.description: Enable Software Command lists for DX11 (Avoid using deferred contexts)

r_fallback_texture_lod_scale.description: Scale factor for requested texture size (texture streaming) - used for geo that doesn't have a precomputed UV density measure

r_farz.description: Override the far clipping plane. -1 means to use the value in env_fog_controller.

r_lightmap_size_directional_irradiance.description: Maximum lightmap resolution for directional_irradiance channel. -1 = use value of r_lightmap_size

r_low_latency.description: NVIDIA Low Latency/AMD Anti-Lag 2 (0 = off, 1 = on, 2 = NV-only, on + boost)

r_mapextents.description: Set the max dimension for the map.  This determines the far clipping plane

r_particle_fixedrandomseeds.description: Use fixed seeds for easier debugging

r_particle_max_size_cull.description: Particle systems larger than this in every dimension skip culling to save CPU.  They will be drawn anyway.

r_particle_min_timestep.description: A minimum on particle simulation time, particle simulation happening more frequently than this will lerp.

r_particle_newinput.description: Enable input path in particle ops

r_renderdoc_auto_shader_pdbs.description: Automatically generate shader debug info on capture

r_size_cull_threshold.description: Threshold of screen size percentage below which objects get culled

r_size_cull_threshold_shadow.description: Threshold of shadow map size percentage below which objects get culled

r_ssao.description: Set to use screen-space ambient occlusion

r_texture_budget_dynamic.description: Dynamically adjust texture streaming budget based on GPU memory usage.

r_texture_budget_threshold.description: Reduce texture memory pool size when this percentage of the budget is full.

r_texture_budget_update_period.description: Time (in seconds) between updating texture memory budget.

r_texture_lod_scale.description: Scale factor for requested texture size (texture streaming)

r_texture_nonstreaming_load.description: Allow immediately loading mips of textures (when possible) when their headers are loaded, saving IO & reducing latency.

r_texture_pool_reduce_rate.description: Reduce texture memory pool size by this many MB / s when over budget.

r_texture_pool_size.description: Total size of the texture pool in MB

r_texture_stream_max_resolution.description: Maximum resolution for top mip level in streaming textures

r_texture_stream_mip_bias.description: Biases the mip level the texture streaming system choses to stream for each texture.

r_texturefilteringquality.description: 0: Bilinear, 1: Trilinear, 2: Aniso 2x, 3: Aniso 4x, 4: Aniso 8x, 5: Aniso 16x

rate.description: Min bytes/sec the host can receive data

reset_voice_on_input_stallout.description: If true, resets the input device when there was a long enough hitch between callbacks.

rope_smooth_enlarge.description: How much to enlarge ropes in screen space for antialiasing effect

rope_smooth_minwidth.description: When using smoothing, this is the min screenspace width it lets a rope shrink to

rope_wind_dist.description: Don't use CPU applying small wind gusts to ropes when they're past this distance.

rtx_dynamic_blas.description: Allow dynamic BLAS creation for geometry going through the compute shader skinning path.

rtx_dynamic_blas_caching.description: Cache dynamic BLAS if geometry has not changed

rtx_force_default_hitgroup.description: Forces all ray traced geometry to use default hit shaders instead of specialized ones.

rtx_texture_resolution.description: Sets the texture resolution the raytracer will mark to stream in

sc_aggregate_indirect_draw_compaction_th.description: Threshold of indirect draws when we will do compaction

sc_aggregate_render_mesh_shader.description: Using mesh shaders if available instead of drawcalls

sc_allow_dithered_lod.description: Allow use of dithered lod transitions

sc_clutter_density_full_size.description: Screen-size where clutter will be full density

sc_clutter_density_none_size.description: Screen-size where clutter will be gone

sc_dithered_lod_transition_amt.description: Percentage of the transition between two lods we will apply a dither

sc_hdr_enabled_override.description: Override default setting for HDR rendering. -1 default, 0 NoHdr, 1 Hdr, 2 Hdr 1010102 3 Hdr 111110

sc_instanced_mesh_lod_bias.description: Bias for LOD selection of instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_lod_bias_shadow.description: Bias for LOD selection of instanced meshes in shadowmaps

sc_instanced_mesh_motion_vectors.description: Toggles motion vector support for instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_opaque_fade.description: Toggles fade support for instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_size_cull_bias.description: Bias for size culling of instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_size_cull_bias_shadow.description: Bias for size culling instanced meshes in shadowmaps

skeleton_instance_lod_optimization.description: Compute LOD mask internally like since 2016, i.e. force all LOD groups' bones to compute

snd_boxverb_simd.description: Enable SIMD code path for shoebox reverb processor.

snd_steamaudio_baked_dimensions_probeloo.description: Use alternate probe lookup algorithm to query dimensions for listener position based on kd-tree of probe points.

snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_out.description: Enable baking outside field for probes baking custom dimensions data.

snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_siz.description: Enable baking size and inout data for probes when baking custom dimensions data.

snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_sma.description: Enable baking insize size field for probes when baking custom dimensions data.

snd_steamaudio_dimensions_grid_height_ma.description: The maximum height (from the ground) we allow probes to be added above the initial layer. (meters)

snd_steamaudio_dimensions_max_ray_length.description: 0 is disabled, but otherwise sets a limit the maximum ray size in the dimension size calculation. Used to model the enclosure algorithm. Game units

snd_steamaudio_enable_pathing.description: This variable is checked by soundstack to globally enabling pathing for audio processing.

snd_steamaudio_invalid_path_length.description: Path length of invalid path in inches. Set this to .0 to use direct distance as path length.

snd_steamaudio_ir_duration.description: The time delay between a sound being emitted and the last audible reflection in Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_load_dimensions_data.description: If set, baked dimensions data is loaded.

snd_steamaudio_load_materials_data.description: If set, baked materials data is loaded.

snd_steamaudio_load_occlusion_data.description: If set, baked occlusion data is loaded.

snd_steamaudio_load_pathing_data.description: If set, baked pathing data is loaded. Steam Audio Hammer entities can successfully use pathing in this case.

snd_steamaudio_load_reverb_data.description: If set, baked reverb data is loaded. Reset it to zero during an format changes of baked data until all data is updated.

snd_steamaudio_max_occlusion_samples.description: The maximum number of rays that can be traced for volumetric occlusion by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_max_probes_customdata_dim.description: Maximum number of probes to create when baking custom data (dimensions).

snd_steamaudio_num_diffuse_samples.description: The number of directions considered for ray bounce by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_num_threads.description: Sets the number of threads used for realtime reflection by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_pathing_order.description: The amount of directional detail in the simulated by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_pathing_order_rendering.description: The amount of directional detail in the rendered audio by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_reverb_level_db.description: Adjust overall volume (dB) of the output from Steam Audio Reverb processor.

snd_steamaudio_reverb_order_rendering.description: Ambisonics order to use for convolution reverb. 0th order = 1 channel, 1st order = 4 channels.

snd_steamaudio_reverb_update_rate.description: Set the maximum update rate (in Hz) for reverb.

sparseshadowtree_disable_add_layers.description: Disable SST runtime layers, for debugging (will exclude geo that CAN render into SST if SST otherwise enabled)

sparseshadowtree_disable_for_viewmodel.description: Disable SST generation and runtime for viewmodel (use original CSM rendering).

sparseshadowtree_enable_rendering.description: Enable use of SST at runtime (static geo rendered into cascades via SST).

sparseshadowtree_leaf_precision_viewmode.description: (viewmodel) precision for depth compression at SST leaf nodes.

sv_lagcomp_filterbyviewangle.description: If true, player pawn will filter lag compensation targets by their view angle.

sv_maxunlag_player.description: If >0, maximumum lag compensation used for other human pawns. Applied after sv_maxunlag!

sv_minrate.description: Min bandwidth rate allowed on server, 0 == unlimited

sv_parallel_checktransmit.description: Set to 1 to use threaded checkentities for transmit/pvs on listen servers, 2 for dedicated servers.

sv_waterdist.description: Vertical view fixup when eyes are near water plane.

tv_enable_delta_frames.description: Indicates whether or not the tv should use delta frames for storage of intermediate frames. This takes more CPU but significantly less memory.

v8_maximum_heap_size_mb.description: Hard limit for the v8 heap size (in mBytes)

vis_sunlight_enable.description: Toggle whether to use sunlight PVS for sunlight views (0 = sky PVS, 1 = sunlight PVS)

voice_always_sample_mic.description: When enabled, open the voip audio input stream when the application launches.

voice_input_stallout.description: Time before we consider a mic stalled out and need to reset it.
